statements.impact_statement: On current main 6af41b7f26017f8875cbc9f5d202ad455502e9c9, offline Gradle dependencyInsight for pension-service runtimeClasspath resolves org.hibernate.reactive:hibernate-reactive-core:3.4.2.Final through quarkus-bom 3.38.0. The inspected local jar SHA-256 is 7e7443b2b5313b043af3d9448499f44059fa77729ddb9e369c4a2b9a9cea075c, exactly the value pinned in gradle/verification-metadata.xml. The upstream fix cd7f104e10de918004707ca0e26e3840976f780a for GHSA-frpp-8pwq-hjrx makes SqlClientConnection.close() validate and roll back an open transaction. javap -c -p of this exact jar shows close() calling validateNoTransactionInProgressOnClose() and the replacement private boolean closed field. The identical probe has no match in the pre-fix 4.2.0.Final Maven Central jar and matches in the first fixed 4.2.1.Final jar. The advisory's broad < 4.2.1 range spans parallel release lines; this bytecode proves the vulnerable pre-fix behavior is absent from the build-resolved 3.4.2.Final artifact. This statement covers the resolved runtime classpath, not an independently verified deployed image.
